title: 第17章 冲动是魔鬼第18章 三人异变
slug: 给你玉女心经没让你用双修证道
content_zh:
早上晴儿刚进门，便发现房间的异常。
见到月儿的肤色明显变好，少爷也在熟睡，晴儿若有所思。
小丫头有些奇怪，少爷不是一直防备月儿么？
“姐姐，我昨晚没睡好，今天就不过来了。”
见到晴儿过来，月儿赶紧找个理由跑路，这丫头怕看到黄夜醒过来。
“嗯，我一个人照顾少爷就行，你回去休息吧！”
月儿前脚离开房间，晴儿立刻推了推黄夜，果不其然，跟死猪没区别。
这家伙心真大，前两天还信誓旦旦防住月儿，还把自己弄成这样。
黄夜再次睡到下午才醒。
迷迷瞪瞪睁开眼睛，看着身旁的晴儿，目光中带着一丝疑惑。
晴儿也睁大眼睛看着这货。
“少爷醒了！”
“嗯！我好像又昏睡了，真是奇怪，现在是什么时辰？”黄夜问道。
“少爷，现在已经下午了。”
“什么！我睡了这么久。”
急忙四下看看，手还从头到脚摸了摸，没发现自己什么异常，一颗心才放下。
“月儿呢？”
“月儿早上就回去了。”
“昨晚她一直在我身边？”
“没错。”晴儿应道。

“奇怪，她怎么没动手？”黄夜喃喃自语道。
“我也奇怪，您不是一直防备月儿，怎会睡过去？”晴儿不解地问道。
“我也不知道，昨晚我一直盯着月儿，没想到睡过去了。”黄夜也是一头雾水。
“少爷，是不是您修炼的功法有问题？”晴儿提醒道。
“功法能有什么问题？”
“看来少爷真的什么都不记得。”晴儿不满的嘟起小嘴。
“我记得什么？”黄夜很是不解。
听了晴儿的描述，黄夜大脑彻底宕机，怎么会这样，自己竟然完全无意识。
这特么叫什么事儿。
本来还准备查到月儿的上家，把他们一网打尽。
现在还怎么出手，这叫我情何以堪！
“月儿早上有什么异常？”黄夜苦着脸问道。
“我早上过来，她说没睡好就回去休息了。”
“少爷，今后怎么办？月儿还不知道您已经清醒。”
“我也不知道，其实有件事儿怕你担心一直没告诉你，月儿曾经几次要杀我。”
“第一次是她给我下药，然后用匕首刺杀我，幸好被我躲过去，就是你肚子疼那天，后来你也进屋，她才没得手。”
“之后还有两次，她都拿出匕首，只是不知何故，最后都放弃了。”
黄夜把月儿的故事讲了一遍。
晴儿已是怒火中烧，噌地跳下床，光着小脚丫便要冲出去。
小丫头真的吓坏了，尤其昨晚黄夜是彻底失去意识，想想后背就冒冷汗。

“回来！”黄夜赶紧叫停，这妞也太冲动了。
“少爷，丫环弑主是重罪，死丫头竟然敢刺杀你，我这就去告诉大夫人。”晴儿怒道。
“告你个头，遇事能不能先冷静一下，冲动是魔鬼。”黄夜训斥道。
“少爷，您的事儿我冷静不下来。”晴儿嘟囔道。
content_en:
As soon as Qing'er entered the door in the morning, she noticed something strange in the room.
Seeing that Yue'er's complexion had improved significantly and the young master was sleeping soundly, Qing'er was thoughtful.
The little girl is a little strange, isn't the young master always on guard against Yue'er?
"Sister, I didn't sleep well last night, so I won't come over today."
Seeing Qing'er coming, Yue'er quickly found a reason to run away. This girl was afraid of seeing Huang Ye wake up.
"Well, I can take care of the young master by myself. You can go back and rest!"
Yue'er left the room with her front legs, and Qing'er immediately pushed Huang Ye. As expected, she was no different from a dead pig.
This guy has such a big heart. Two days ago he vowed to guard against Yue'er, and yet he made himself like this.
Huang Ye slept again until the afternoon before waking up.
Mi Mi opened her eyes and looked at Qing'er beside her, with a trace of doubt in her eyes.
Qing'er also looked at this guy with wide eyes.
"Master, wake up!"
"Hmm! I seem to have fallen asleep again. It's really strange. What time is it now?" Huang Ye asked.
"Master, it's already afternoon now."
"What! I slept for so long."
He looked around hurriedly and touched his head from head to toe. He found nothing unusual about himself, and he was relieved.
"Where's Yue'er?"
"Yue'er will go back in the morning."
"She was with me last night?"
"That's right." Qing'er responded.
"Strange, why didn't she take action?" Huang Ye murmured to himself.
"I'm also surprised, how could you fall asleep if you weren't always on guard against Yue'er?" Qing'er asked in confusion.
"I don't know either. I kept staring at Yue'er last night and didn't expect to fall asleep." Huang Ye was also confused.
"Master, is there something wrong with the technique you practice?" Qing'er reminded.
"What could be wrong with the technique?"
"It seems that the young master really doesn't remember anything." Qing'er pouted in dissatisfaction.
"What do I remember?" Huang Ye was very puzzled.
After listening to Qing'er's description, Huang Ye's brain completely shut down. How could this happen? He was completely unconscious.
What the hell is this?
Originally, he was planning to find Yue'er's family members and catch them all.
How can I take action now? This makes me feel so embarrassed!
"What happened to Yue'er this morning?" Huang Ye asked with a grimace.
"I came over in the morning and she said she didn't sleep well so she went back to rest."
"Master, what will we do next? Yue'er doesn't know you are awake yet."
"I don't know either. In fact, there is something I haven't told you for fear of worrying you. Yue'er has tried to kill me several times."
"The first time she drugged me and then stabbed me to death with a dagger. Fortunately, I dodged her. That was the day you had a stomachache. Later, you also entered the house, so she didn't succeed."
"Twice after that, she took out the dagger, but for some reason, she gave up in the end."
Huang Ye told Yue'er's story again.
Qing'er was already furious, jumped out of bed, and wanted to rush out with her bare feet.
The little girl was really frightened, especially since Huang Ye had completely lost consciousness last night, and cold sweat broke out on her back just thinking about it.
"Come back!" Huang Ye quickly stopped. This girl was too impulsive.
"Young Master, it is a serious crime for a maid to kill her master. This dead girl dares to assassinate you. I will tell the eldest lady right now." Qing'er said angrily.
"I'm telling you, could you calm down first when something happens? Impulsiveness is the devil." Huang Ye scolded.
"Master, I can't calm down about your matter." Qing'er muttered.
